title: feat(spec): declare `record:reference_rail` in ComponentPropsMap — undeclared rail keys refused (#8691)
body:
Fixes #8691

## What

Adds the strict `record:reference_rail` row to `ComponentPropsMap` (37 → 38 keys), so the #5068 component-props gate's dispatch reaches the rail: the issue's planted entry `filter` — which passed tsc, `objectstack validate`, `objectstack build`, and shipped verbatim while rendering nothing — is now a loud `component-props-unknown-key` refusal with a prescription, and the shape the renderer actually reads is accepted byte-identically.

## Key set — measured, not transcribed (one PM mechanism assumption falsified)

The dispatch card listed the renderer consuming `objectName / relationshipField / limit / title / icon / displayField` + component-level `hideEmpty`. Verified against the actual console renderer at the repo's `.objectui-sha` pin (`665661ab…`, which is exactly what the local objectui checkout was at — `plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-reference-rail.tsx`):

- **`icon` is falsified as a read point**: it appears in the renderer's TS interface and the page synthesizer emits it, but no render path reads it — the rail card has no icon slot (grep: the only hit in the renderer is the interface declaration). Declaring it would be declared-but-unenforced surface, the exact defect class this row closes. It is a `guidance` refusal instead ("read by nothing — remove it"), not a declared key.
- **`title` is `z.string()`, not `I18nLabelSchema`**: the renderer paints it as a raw React child, so an inline locale map would render as a broken object literal. The inline-map capability question stays with the console seat (explicitly out of scope per the card); refusing the map spelling makes no pull judgement.
- `limit` / `hideEmpty` are optional with **no schema default** (the `maxVisible` principle at `record:details`): the renderer's `3` / `true` fallbacks stay the renderer's facts.
- Everything else confirmed: entry `objectName` (required), `relationshipField` (required), `displayField?`, component-level `entries` (min 1) + `hideEmpty?`. `className` stays a component-NODE key per `COMPONENT_LEVEL_GUIDANCE`.
- Aliases (neighbouring-surface spellings): `items` / `related` → `entries`; `object` → `objectName`; `label` → `title`. Guidance: `filter` (points at `record:related_list`, where `filter` is real), `icon`, entry-level `hideEmpty` (wrong layer).

## Pins, both directions

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component-reference-rail.test.ts`: planted `filter` refused with the prescription; real shape accepted byte-identically (deep-equal round-trip, no defaults materialized); `icon` / locale-map `title` / entry-level `hideEmpty` refused; aliases named; min-1 entries; derived react record-context-gate coverage.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts`: the end-to-end dispatch pin — the planted filter produces exactly one `component-props-unknown-key` finding naming the rail, and the real shape stays silent.

## Reverse verification (direction fixed before running: red = silence restored)

Committed the fix first, then ablated only the map row, rebuilt `packages/spec` and proved the mutation reached `dist/` (`Object.keys(ComponentPropsMap)` → rail absent, **37 keys — the card's own measured count**). The lint dispatch pin then failed with `expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`: the planted filter finding dropped 1 → 0, the pre-fix silence, exactly as predicted. Restored from the commit; the restored build's input hash matched the original fix build (`3305e437…`).

## Changeset and registration

Acceptance-narrowing after the v17.0.0 cut ⇒ changeset `minor` + BREAKING body + `adr-0087: registered ui-reference-rail-unknown-keys-refused`; semantic entry under protocol-18 (`18.ui-reference-rail-unknown-keys-refused.ts`), `registry.ts` regenerated via `gen:migration-registry` (the PR #8666 / PR #8695 precedent). ADR-0122: both new schemas are default-free, so they pin isomorphic (`Iso845` / `Iso846`) rather than declaring `Parsed` aliases.

## Verification at HEAD `e347bbe0f` (post-merge of origin/main, final commit)

- `@objectstack/spec`: 401 test files / **10603 passed**, typecheck green (incl. `check:test-typecheck`)
- `@objectstack/lint` (the map's direct consumer — downstream direction): 72 files / **2026 passed**, `tsc --noEmit` green after building the lint dependency closure
- `check:generated`: **13/13 up to date** (api-surface, export-origins, docs references, strictness ledger regenerated via `--fix`, only the four proved stale; authorable-surface anchor rewrite kept as generated)
- Derived gate battery (`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` over the actual changed paths — additions beyond the prompt's list: `check:spec-parsed-alias`, the test-file convention trio): `check:nul-bytes`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:merge-driver`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check:quick-reference-counts`, `check:role-word`, `check:spec-parsed-alias`, `check:type-source-resolution`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt --re-measure` (none above recorded), `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-dev-prereqs`, `check:doc-formula-expressions` — all green
- `check:react-declaration-parity` cannot run here (needs objectui's sdui.manifest, pin-bump-triggered by settled ruling)

## Out of scope

The two console-side items the card excludes (rail title vs `pluralLabel`; untranslatable literal title) are not addressed here and remain with the console seat. Sibling finding filed as #8744 (`record:alert` / `record:quick_actions` / `record:history` have no row — same mechanism); #8744 remains open and is not part of this PR.
